notes: Confucius4-R2T2 through the zoo sample app asr_litertlm (one app for three LiteRT-LM speech bundles: a model picker, hold-to-talk up to 30 s, three FLEURS clips of 9.72 / 6.42 / 11.04 s) on litertlm-android 0.17.1, the published file of mlboydaisuke/Confucius4-R2T2-LiteRT (snapshot 5883303a) pushed with adb (HF cache blob = the sha256 below; md5 on the phone equal to the Mac copy). The device check runs in the instrumentation process (cpuset /foreground in this lane's measurements of the same phone), not the app on screen. latency_p50_ms = the median of the three clips' sendMessage walls (one Conversation per clip, encoder + language model), rtf = their sum / the audio seconds; every clip's text equals the expected text (the Mac CPU answer of litert-lm-api 0.17.1), so output_match stays null (#173(2)); peak_mem_mb = the largest VmHWM the check printed (the instrumentation process, memory-mapped bundle pages included). The supervisor's rerun of the same check on the same phone the next day (no reboot in between), one bundle at a time, cooled until the CPU ceilings were at their maximum (scaling_max_* at the start); the README of asr_litertlm and the zoo table carry these numbers (LiteRT-Models 4c64ba4). The rerun log states no OS build, so os_build is Android 16 only (the device log of the day before states BP4A.251205.006.S942QOPS1AZH9).
quantization: LM int8 dynamic (int8 embedding table); audio encoder fp16 weights, fp32 compute, in-graph log-mel, 30 s window (390 audio tokens); KV cache 1024; litert-torch Qwen3-ASR prompt in the template (mlboydaisuke/Confucius4-R2T2-LiteRT rev b52ffc6f)
